module: Flowgraph node "Simple Timer" (category once_f_duration). All-in-one timer: creates a timer (duration, ref dtSim/dtReal/dtRaw) on trigger, then publishes elapsed, remaining, duration, elapsedPercent (0 to 1) every frame; capTime clamps these values once finished. Goes to duration state 'started' then 'finished' when the timer is complete. Values cannot be modified after creation.
notes: onNodeReset contains debug prints (message "setting timer back").
elapsedPercent divides by the duration: a duration of 0 gives inf/NaN.

onNodeReset.desc: Resets the timer's elapsed time to 0 and the duration state to 'inactive'.

postInit.desc: Defines the preset values of the ref pin (dtSim, dtReal, dtRaw).

work.desc: Updates elapsed/remaining/duration/elapsedPercent, switches to 'finished' when the timer is complete.

workOnce.desc: Creates the timer via self.mgr.modules.timer:addTimer, publishes timerId and sets the duration state to 'started'.
